result.summary: Found 2 issues: a missing icon in the bottom tab bar and a restaurant name clipped at the end of a carousel card.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation has no icon, only the label, while Home, Search, and Profile all have icons.
issues.suggestion: Add a consistent icon for the Orders tab so the navigation bar is complete and visually aligned.

issues.description: The restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol” is cut off at the right edge of its card in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines or truncate with an ellipsis so the full title remains readable.
